test_mode.description: Run blendsel in test mode; do not install or remove packages. Corresponds to -t/--test.

new_install.description: Enable automatic task selection without user prompt, used during new Debian installations. Corresponds to --new-install.

list_tasks.description: List all available tasks to stdout instead of launching the UI. Corresponds to --list-tasks.

task_packages.description: List packages available for these tasks to stdout. Corresponds to --task-packages task (repeatable).

task_desc.description: Output the extended description for this single task to stdout. Corresponds to --task-desc task.

debconf_apt_progress.description: Space-separated options to pass to the debconf-apt-progress command. Corresponds to --debconf-apt-progress options.
